title: Short-Term UV-C Irradiation of Duckweed (_Lemna_ sp.) to Study Morphogenesis and Survival
author: Evhenii Hordiienko

steps.title: Isolate Duckweed Plants
steps.instruction: Isolate 4 healthy young Lemna sp. individuals from the maternal colony exactly 3 days before starting the irradiation procedure.

steps.title: Prepare Nutrient Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare a nutrient medium of distilled water supplemented with 5.56% sucrose and transfer 50 ml into a transparent, BPA-free plastic container (100 ml capacity).

steps.title: Perform UV-C Irradiation
steps.instruction: Expose the plants to UV-C radiation using an ozone-free UV lamp (254 nm).

substeps.instruction: Place the 4 selected individuals into the prepared medium container.
Position the radiation source at a strict distance of 26 cm from the object.
Expose the plants to radiation continuously for 60 seconds.

steps.title: Transfer and Cultivate Plants
steps.instruction: Immediately after the 60-second exposure, transfer the irradiated plants into a fresh nutrient medium of identical composition.

substeps.instruction: Maintain cultivation under dim light (~6500 K).

steps.title: Observe and Fix Material
steps.instruction: Monitor the culture for morphogenetic changes and fix the material for preservation.

substeps.instruction: Perform systematic observations on days 4, 6, 8, and 9 post-exposure.
On day 9, terminate live observation and fix the experimental material in 70% ethanol.
